## Verdict

Gable costs least for a team of 22 people, at $242 per month. It is the only vendor whose minimum seat count (10) sits below the team size, so no seats are wasted. Lumen Path forces payment for 25 seats and Estuary for 50, inflating both well past their headline per-seat rates.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $11 | 10 |
| Lumen Path | $15 | 25 |
| Estuary | $21 | 50 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (22) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger.

- **Gable:** minimum 10 is below 22, so 22 seats paid. 22 × $11 = **$242 per month**.
- **Lumen Path:** minimum 25 exceeds 22, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $15 = **$375 per month**. Three seats, worth $45, go unused.
- **Estuary:** minimum 50 exceeds 22, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $21 = **$1,050 per month**. 28 seats, worth $588, go unused.

Gable is $133 per month cheaper than Lumen Path and $808 per month cheaper than Estuary. Over twelve months that is $1,596 and $9,696 respectively. Gable's effective rate is $11.00 per person; Lumen Path's is $17.05 per person at 22 people; Estuary's is $47.73 per person.

## Risks

This comparison covers list price only. The price list states no feature, support, or capacity differences between the three vendors, so a cheaper seat may buy less — that is unverified either way from the source given.

Seat minimums create cliffs. Growth past 25 people narrows the Lumen Path gap on a per-person basis, though Gable stays cheaper per seat at every size on this list. Shrinking below 10 people leaves Gable billing a 10-seat minimum.

All figures assume monthly billing, as the price list specifies. Annual commitments, discounts, onboarding fees, and overage charges are not covered by the source and could change the ranking.
